name: book-translator
purpose: Agent-native, resumable literary book translation with source-comparison review.

version_policy.rule: Use the latest main when the user does not explicitly pin a tag, commit, or branch; resolve that ref once at setup and keep the resolved revision stable for the active book run.

bootstrap.collision_rule: Never overwrite a pre-existing unrelated file. If a runtime-path collision exists in a host repository, install the entire runtime set under .book-translator instead of mixing canonical and host files.

completion_requirement: Every intended chapter is reviewed under AGENTS.md and repository state validates.

capability_fallbacks.filesystem_and_git: Clone the requested repository ref, resolve it to a concrete revision, check out that resolved revision, and work from that stable revision.
capability_fallbacks.repository_api_without_shell: Read the canonical files from the resolved revision through the available repository API and create/update equivalent workflow files in the writable target workspace without overwriting unrelated host files.
capability_fallbacks.isolated_workers_unavailable: Execute Translator and Reviewer as separate bounded-context roles in one agent session while preserving independent review and orchestrator-owned state transitions.
capability_fallbacks.read_only: Read the instructions, state exactly what cannot be performed, and give the minimum manual step needed. Do not claim setup or file writes occurred.
